requirements.statement: Implementation phases MUST advance in dependency order and a phase MUST NOT advance beyond its hard acceptance gate until that gate passes.
requirements.source: Continuum v1.2 Phase-by-Phase Execution Plan — phase order and hard acceptance gates

requirements.statement: Advanced autonomous components MUST remain disabled until foundational evidence, safety, evaluation, and rollback systems are proven.
requirements.source: Continuum v1.2 Phase-by-Phase Execution Plan — controlled activation of Watchers, Tool Factory, Mutation Engine, and autonomous improvement

requirements.statement: Major implementation subsystems MUST have objective acceptance criteria and machine-verifiable evidence where practical before being treated as complete.
requirements.source: Continuum v1.2 Phase-by-Phase Execution Plan — hard acceptance gates and machine-verifiable checks

requirements.statement: Foundation MUST establish Temporal as the durable execution layer with deterministic workflow boundaries before higher-level reasoning capabilities depend on it.
requirements.source: Continuum v1.2 Master Implementation Specification — Temporal orchestration boundary and Foundation sequence

requirements.statement: An implementation choice that is not directly supported by recovered v1.2 source material MUST be recorded as an ADR or source gap instead of being represented as recovered specification text.
requirements.source: Approved Continuum implementation-control policy and GitHub issue #2

requirements.statement: The implementation control plane MUST provide evidence and status but MUST NOT auto-merge pull requests; merge remains a human-controlled gate.
